# Cash and Energy Update

Report 119 | Published 2023-09-17 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-9-17/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/119.json)

Cash, energy and custody.

Bitcoin’s 2024-2025 direction succeeded. The six-month equity caution and durable oil floor failed. Custody architecture needs legal and operational qualifications; cash comparisons need consistent monetary aggregates. The 2019 QT chronology is incorrect. Long commodity horizons remain open.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

## Claims

| --- | --- |

The broad directional caution failed over its stated horizon: SPY gained 15.75% from September 18, 2023 to March 15, 2024 versus BIL 2.64%. An intervening autumn drawdown does not turn the full six-month outcome into sustained market weakness.

## Framework lessons

- Match timing, vehicle and mechanism.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
- Chart pixels were not inspected; exact chart-only assertions remain flagged.
